result.question: Why is Athaliah killed at king's house?

readings.answer: Because the priest said she must not be executed in the LORD’s house, so they took her out to the palace to kill her.
readings.support: For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”

readings.answer: Because she had reached the palace entrance, so they killed her there.
readings.support: as she reached the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds, and there she was put to death

assessments.reason: It cites the explicit reason in v15—“For the priest had said, ‘She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD’”—and correctly infers she was therefore taken to the palace to be killed (v16).
It treats her arrival at the palace entrance as the cause, but the text gives the reason as the priest’s order not to execute her in the LORD’s house (v15); v16 states where it happened, not why.

result.reason: The passage explicitly gives the reason: the priest said she must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
